answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 150827 Country: India Title: Is it is necessary to undergo circumcision at later age Question: I am newly converted 24 years Muslim and I want to know about circumcise. Is it necessary to perform. I have listened that it is sunnah of marriage. Please mention Hadith book and chapter of book. Answer ID: 150827 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 914/837/SN=8/1438) Imam Bukhari (may Allah have mercy upon him) has recorded this Hadith in Al-Adab al-Mufrad: عن بن شهاب قال : كان الرجل إذا أسلم أمر بالاختتان وإن كان كبيرًا (الأدب المفرد ، رقم : 1252 ، باب الختان للكبير). So, the scholars of fiqh have explained that a person who accepts Islam in late age it is wajib for him to undergo circumcision if he can bear the pain, it is sunnah muwakkidah and necessary. Hence in the question mentioned above, it is sunnah for you to undergo circumcision. You should undergo the circumcision by any expert doctor. Here it should also be noted that circumcision is not the sunnah of marriage rather it is the sunnah of Islam. Hence if you do not marry then too this ruling shall apply. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
